name: avalara
description: Review and manage Avalara transactions, exemptions, returns, and reports through the Avalara Product Portal in your local desktop browser.

interface.shortDescription: Manage tax transactions, exemptions, returns, and reports
interface.longDescription: Review transactions, liabilities, exemptions, returns, and reports through the Avalara Product Portal in your browser. Requires local browser access in ChatGPT Desktop or desktop Codex; not available on web, mobile, or cloud-backed tasks. Make requested record and configuration changes, generate reports, and work through filing and payment workflows with explicit approval for consequential actions. Available workflows depend on your Avalara products, company configuration, role, and permissions. This plugin is built and maintained by OpenAI. It is powered by computer use, and is not an Avalara-provided API or MCP integration.
defaultPrompt: Review recent Avalara transactions and flag unusual tax calculations.
Summarize liabilities, exemptions, and nexus items that need attention.
Update the Avalara transaction I select and show me the result.
